title: Best Fuel Rewards South Africa 2026: Compare & Calculate | FreeHub
heading: Fuel rewards in South Africa
description: Compare South African fuel rewards with a practical calculator. Check your eligible rates, monthly limits, points, cashback and combinations before choosing.
intro: Start with the fuel stations you already use. Compare Shell, bp, Sasol and bank or insurance rewards using your own fuel price and the benefits you actually qualify for.

sections.heading: A useful starting point without changing banks
paragraphs: At Shell’s Regular tier, 50 litres earns R7.50 in V+ value. BP Rewards gives R10 on the same volume; swiping Smart Shopper as well offers up to R15 combined in separate balances. These are arithmetic examples before transaction rounding and exclusions, not a guarantee for every purchase.

Sasol’s published rate earns 1,500 points on 50 qualifying litres. We have not confirmed a current official points-to-rands conversion, so we do not rank those points as R15. Check the value and redemption options in your Sasol app. Points cannot be exchanged for cash, expire after 18 months and have a 100-litre earning cap per single account in any 24 hours.

Reward value is useful only if you can redeem it. BP requires at least R20 in its BP Rewards balance before you can spend it on fuel or bp Express purchases. Do not make an unnecessary shop purchase or long detour for a smaller reward.

sources.label: Shell V+ rates and tier rules
Current bp combinations and redemption threshold
Sasol earning, redemption and expiry terms
Sasol free registration and point earning

sections.heading: Shell’s higher tier is a spending condition, not a setting
paragraphs: Select your existing tier in the calculator. Super needs at least four monthly fuel visits of R750 each and two qualifying shop visits. Premium needs five fuel visits of R750 each and five shop purchases of at least R75 each. Ultra needs ten R1,000 fuel visits and five shop purchases of at least R100 each.

Ultra Plus requires maintaining the qualifying tier and 11–29 visits with at least R1,200 per fill. The 50c/litre tier requires more than 30 visits with at least R1,500 per fill, together with the shop and tier rules. A higher fuel reward can be outweighed by spending you would not otherwise make.

Shell’s prose and table describe some shop-spend thresholds differently. This guide uses the stricter per-purchase wording where they differ; confirm your actual tier in the app rather than inferring it from a spending total.

sources.label: Read the complete official V+ tier table

sections.heading: Which rewards can be combined?
paragraphs: bp explicitly allows BP Rewards with Smart Shopper, Greenbacks-linked Nedbank cards or Discovery Insure Vitality Drive. It advertises 20c/litre BP Rewards plus 25c/litre Greenbacks, or BP Rewards plus the qualifying Vitality Drive fuel benefit. Smart Shopper and Discovery Insure cards cannot be swiped together.

Nedbank calculates its fuel reward using the inland ULP 95 price rather than necessarily the litres on your receipt. The calculator keeps that conversion price separate from your pump price. As a result, the combined estimate can differ from multiplying your actual litres by 45c.

Absa’s current Shell instructions require a V+ swipe alongside the qualifying Absa card. Sasol’s current Absa partner page and section 5.7.2 of its terms specifically allow registered members to earn Absa cashback and Sasol points together. Swipe your Sasol Rewards card and pay with the eligible Absa card. The double benefit can be withdrawn, so recheck current terms. Sasol points stay separate from the calculator’s rand totals because their current redemption conversion was not confirmed.

The calculator compares one bank or insurance benefit at a time. It includes only the specifically supported combinations shown in its result row. Discovery Bank and Discovery Insure are separate benefits with separate rules.

sources.label: Sasol confirms the Absa plus points combination

sections.heading: Check the limits behind the bank headlines
paragraphs: For Absa, tier and payment card both matter. At tier 5, the published credit-card rate is 30%, while debit is 4.5%. On R2,500 eligible spend, those rates produce R750 and R112.50 respectively. The partner allowance is R3,000 monthly; include relevant shop spending when working out what remains.

FNB’s qualifying Premier/Private route can combine base earning with vehicle-finance and car-insurance add-ons. Enter your actual base rate and remaining eligible Engen spend from your app. Account-specific caps and a limit linked to 20% of qualifying card spend apply. The insurance add-on cannot exceed 30% of the eligible monthly premium. The calculator also subtracts insurance fuel rewards already earned.

UCount’s R10/litre is the tier-5 credit-card double rate. Without double qualification, that card’s tier-5 rate is R5/litre; Evolve and Debit/Cheque rates are lower. The live fuel page caps qualifying fuel/oil spend at the lower of R2,500 or 20% of qualifying card spend in a fixed cycle. Use your programme’s conversion price and remaining reward allowance.

sources.label: Absa Sasol debit and credit tier table
eBucks Engen account limits and insurance cap
Current UCount fuel rates and conditions

sections.heading: Discovery: insurance and banking have different limits
paragraphs: Vitality Drive can pay up to 50% on eligible fuel/Gautrain spending, with a maximum R1,500 monthly. Driving points control the qualifying spending, and cashback cannot exceed the relevant vehicle premium excluding VAT. Enter your remaining fuel allowance after Gautrain and other rewards. The Core Plan does not provide fuel rewards.

Discovery Bank announces a change from up to 20% fuel rewards to up to 15% from 1 November 2026. The calculator changes its allowed bank percentage on that date, using South African time. A maximum percentage is not your personal percentage: enter the actual rate and limits shown in your app.

Miles and restricted reward balances are shown at their programme rand equivalent, without adding special redemption-day discounts. This comparison does not include acquisition bonuses or assume you should buy a bank or insurance product to reach a higher rate.

sources.label: Discovery fuel cashback calculation and premium cap
Vitality Drive eligibility and Core Plan exclusions

sections.heading: How the estimates are calculated
paragraphs: Forecourt estimate: fuel budget ÷ your pump price × the reward per litre. Bank per-litre estimate: eligible spend ÷ the provider’s conversion price × your eligible rate. Percentage estimate: eligible spend × your percentage, limited by the remaining reward allowance. The pump price is held constant across forecourt alternatives. If stations charge different prices, rerun with each price and compare the actual total cost.

Each result is an alternative for the same fuel budget. The bank result subtracts the extra monthly costs you enter; it does not subtract an existing bank or insurance bill you would pay anyway. Include any additional fee, extra qualifying purchase or travel cost that exists only to obtain that reward.

The calculator processes its inputs locally and does not submit or save them. Existing site cookie and analytics choices still apply. Blank or unknown bank limits exclude that bank estimate, while the forecourt comparison remains available.

Official sources were checked on 11 October 2026. Review rates again before the 1 November Discovery change and whenever your provider updates its terms. No current national petrol price is asserted here. Estimated values may differ because of transaction rounding, eligibility, excluded payments, station participation and programme changes.

faq.question: Which fuel rewards programme is best in South Africa?
faq.answer: The best fit depends on your convenient stations, existing eligible products, actual reward rate, limits and additional costs. Shell Regular starts at 15c/litre, BP Rewards offers a 20c/litre component, and Sasol publishes 30 points/litre. Bank and insurance maximums require additional qualifications.

faq.question: Can I combine BP Rewards with Discovery Insure?
faq.answer: bp and Discovery confirm BP Rewards can be used with Vitality Drive. bp says Smart Shopper and Discovery Insure cards cannot be swiped together. Check eligibility, swipe the required cards and keep the separate reward balances in mind.

faq.question: When does Discovery Bank change its fuel reward?
faq.answer: Discovery Bank announces a maximum of up to 15% from 1 November 2026, compared with up to 20% through October. Your actual rate and remaining spending or reward limits still depend on your programme.

faq.question: Does the calculator need my bank login or personal details?
faq.answer: No. Enter a fuel budget, fuel price and, optionally, the reward details and limits you already know. FreeHub calculates locally in your browser and does not ask for a login, ID number or payment details.
